core_claim.P: HypoVault initializes totalSupply with 1,000,000 shares at deployment without allocating them to any addresses, and fulfillDeposits() adds new shares to totalSupply before allocating them via executeDeposit()
core_claim.I: ERC20 invariant that totalSupply equals the sum of all balances, so share price reflects only owned shares
core_claim.V: phantom shares exist in totalSupply but are owned by no one, violating totalSupply ≠ sum of all balances and diluting users' value

distinct_impacts.description: Phantom bootstrap shares inflate totalSupply, so share prices are calculated on an inflated supply and users receive far less than they should
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Share prices are calculated using an inflated `totalSupply` which results in users getting far less than they should.

distinct_impacts.description: Phantom shares steal a significant proportion of the vault's value, causing users to lose 66% of their true value
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Phantom shares “steal” a significant proportion of the vault’s value, resulting in users losing 66% of their true value.

distinct_impacts.description: The two-step fulfillDeposits()/executeDeposit() process creates a permanent accounting imbalance
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This two-step process creates a permanent accounting imbalance.

distinct_impacts.description: ERC20 invariant totalSupply ≠ sum of all balances is violated
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This violates the fundamental ERC20 standard `totalSupply ≠ sum of all balances`.
